text: Security is a vital part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and the server. Strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor login, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Developers must also check all input carefully with input validation, because unsafe data can damage the system. Common vulnerabilities, like SQL injection and cross-site scripting, are serious threats that can steal private information. By following good security practices from the start, developers can build safer websites and protect their users from harm.
